_disclaimer: This dataset is an ORIGINAL, condensed paraphrase of the public PCI DSS v4.0 requirement structure, written for use as demo/training data in this student project. It is NOT a reproduction of the official PCI Security Standards Council (PCI SSC) document, is NOT complete, and MUST NOT be used as an authoritative compliance reference. Before any real assessment, the official PCI DSS v4.0.1 standard must be purchased/downloaded from https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org and used as the source of truth.

requirements.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls

sub_requirements.title: Processes and mechanisms for network security controls
sub_requirements.summary: Documented, up-to-date network security policies and role responsibilities exist and are known to affected staff.
example_evidence: Org chart / RACI for network security

sub_requirements.title: Network security control configuration
sub_requirements.summary: Firewalls/routers (NSCs) are configured, with a current network diagram, to restrict traffic to only what is necessary for the cardholder data environment (CDE).

sub_requirements.title: Restricting connections to/from the CDE
sub_requirements.summary: Inbound/outbound traffic to the CDE is restricted to only necessary, authorized traffic; direct public access to CDE components is prevented.

sub_requirements.title: Controls between trusted/untrusted networks
sub_requirements.summary: Controls exist between the CDE and untrusted networks (e.g., the internet), including anti-spoofing measures.

sub_requirements.title: Risk mitigation for computing devices connecting to multiple networks
sub_requirements.summary: Laptops/mobile devices with independent connectivity that also connect to the CDE have controls to mitigate risk.

requirements.title: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for secure configurations
sub_requirements.summary: Documented configuration standards and role responsibilities exist for hardening systems.

sub_requirements.title: System components configured and managed securely
sub_requirements.summary: Configuration standards are developed, applied, and kept updated for all system components, addressing known security parameters (e.g., disabling unnecessary services).

sub_requirements.title: Wireless environments configured securely
sub_requirements.summary: Wireless vendor defaults are changed and wireless environments are configured securely.

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for protecting stored account data
sub_requirements.summary: Data retention/disposal and protection policies for stored account data are documented and followed.

sub_requirements.title: Storage of account data is minimized
sub_requirements.summary: Account data storage is limited to what is necessary, per documented retention/disposal requirements.

sub_requirements.title: Sensitive authentication data (SAD) is not stored after authorization
sub_requirements.summary: Full track data, CVV/CVC, and PIN data are not retained after authorization.

sub_requirements.title: Primary Account Number (PAN) access/display is restricted
sub_requirements.summary: PAN is masked when displayed and access is restricted to those with a legitimate business need.
example_evidence: Screenshot of masked PAN in application

sub_requirements.title: PAN is secured wherever stored
sub_requirements.summary: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored (e.g., via strong one-way hashing, tokenization, or strong encryption with key management).

sub_requirements.title: Cryptographic keys protecting stored account data are secured
sub_requirements.summary: Key-management processes and procedures cover generation, distribution, storage, rotation and destruction of keys.

sub_requirements.title: Key-management processes support cryptographic key protection
sub_requirements.summary: Formal key-management processes exist covering the full key lifecycle.

requirements.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for protecting data in transit
sub_requirements.summary: Policies for protecting cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks are documented.

sub_requirements.title: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission
sub_requirements.summary: Strong cryptography (e.g., current TLS versions/ciphers) protects PAN when transmitted over open, public networks; only trusted keys/certificates accepted.

requirements.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for protection against malware
sub_requirements.summary: Anti-malware policies and responsibilities are documented and known.

sub_requirements.title: Malicious software is prevented/detected/addressed
sub_requirements.summary: Anti-malware solutions are deployed on applicable system components and kept current.

sub_requirements.title: Anti-malware mechanisms are actively running and monitored
sub_requirements.summary: Anti-malware runs continuously, cannot be disabled by users, and is monitored/logged.

sub_requirements.title: Anti-phishing mechanisms protect users
sub_requirements.summary: Mechanisms exist to detect and protect personnel against phishing attacks.

requirements.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for secure systems and software
sub_requirements.summary: Secure development policies and roles are documented.

sub_requirements.title: Bespoke/custom software is developed securely
sub_requirements.summary: Custom software follows secure coding standards and developer training addressing common vulnerability classes.

sub_requirements.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed
sub_requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities are identified (via a recognized methodology / vulnerability intel) and patches applied within defined timeframes.

sub_requirements.title: Public-facing web applications are protected
sub_requirements.summary: Public-facing web apps are reviewed regularly for vulnerabilities or protected by an automated technical solution (e.g., WAF).

sub_requirements.title: Changes are managed securely
sub_requirements.summary: Change-management processes control changes to system components, including impact and rollback documentation.

requirements.title: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for restricting access
sub_requirements.summary: Access control policies based on least privilege/need-to-know are documented.

sub_requirements.title: Access is defined and assigned appropriately
sub_requirements.summary: An access control model defines access needs per role, and access is assigned based on job classification/function.

sub_requirements.title: Access is managed via an access control system
sub_requirements.summary: An access control system enforces need-to-know and is configured to deny-by-default with periodic review.

requirements.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for identification and authentication
sub_requirements.summary: Identification/authentication policies and responsibilities are documented.

sub_requirements.title: User/device identification is managed
sub_requirements.summary: Unique IDs are assigned to all users and no shared/generic IDs are used for administrative access.

sub_requirements.title: Strong authentication is established/managed
sub_requirements.summary: Strong authentication (passwords/passphrases meeting complexity, or other authentication factors) is enforced.

sub_requirements.title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is implemented
sub_requirements.summary: MFA is implemented for all access into the CDE and for all remote/administrative access.

sub_requirements.title: MFA systems are configured to prevent misuse
sub_requirements.summary: MFA systems are configured so they cannot be bypassed by unauthorized users.

sub_requirements.title: Authentication for application/system accounts is managed
sub_requirements.summary: Use of application and system accounts, and associated authentication factors, is strictly managed.

requirements.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for physical access control
sub_requirements.summary: Physical security policies and responsibilities are documented.

sub_requirements.title: Physical access controls manage entry to facilities
sub_requirements.summary: Controls (badge systems, visitor logs, video monitoring) restrict and monitor physical entry to sensitive areas.

sub_requirements.title: Physical access for personnel and visitors is authorized/managed
sub_requirements.summary: Procedures distinguish personnel from visitors and control/monitor visitor access.

sub_requirements.title: Media with cardholder data is securely stored/destroyed
sub_requirements.summary: Physical media containing cardholder data is classified, securely stored, and destroyed when no longer needed.

sub_requirements.title: Point-of-interaction (POI) devices are protected
sub_requirements.summary: POI devices are protected from tampering and unauthorized substitution.

requirements.title: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for logging and monitoring
sub_requirements.summary: Logging and monitoring policies and responsibilities are documented.

sub_requirements.title: Audit logs support detection of anomalies
sub_requirements.summary: Audit logs are enabled and capture events (user access, admin actions, system changes) for all system components.

sub_requirements.title: Audit logs are protected from destruction/unauthorized modification
sub_requirements.summary: Audit log files are protected via access controls, backups, and integrity monitoring.

sub_requirements.title: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies
sub_requirements.summary: Logs are reviewed daily (automated tools acceptable) with follow-up on exceptions.

sub_requirements.title: Audit log history is retained/available
sub_requirements.summary: At least 12 months of audit log history is retained, with the most recent 3 months immediately available.

sub_requirements.title: Time-synchronization mechanisms support log consistency
sub_requirements.summary: Systems use synchronized time (e.g., NTP) so log timestamps are consistent and reliable.

sub_requirements.title: Failures of critical security controls are detected/reported
sub_requirements.summary: Failures of critical security control systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, AV, logging) are detected and responded to promptly.

requirements.title: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly

sub_requirements.title: Processes/mechanisms for security testing
sub_requirements.summary: Security testing policies and responsibilities (scanning, pentesting) are documented.

sub_requirements.title: Wireless access points are identified and monitored
sub_requirements.summary: Authorized/unauthorized wireless access points are identified on a defined schedule.

sub_requirements.title: External/internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified
sub_requirements.summary: Internal and external vulnerability scans are performed on a defined schedule and after significant changes; high-risk items remediated.

sub_requirements.title: External/internal penetration testing is performed regularly
sub_requirements.summary: Penetration testing (network and application layer) is performed at least annually and after significant changes, with segmentation testing where applicable.

sub_requirements.title: Network intrusions and unexpected file changes are detected/responded to
sub_requirements.summary: Intrusion-detection/prevention and change-detection (file integrity monitoring) mechanisms are deployed and monitored.

sub_requirements.title: Unauthorized changes on payment pages are detected
sub_requirements.summary: A change- and tamper-detection mechanism monitors payment page scripts/content for unauthorized modification.

requirements.title: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs

sub_requirements.title: Comprehensive information security policy is established
sub_requirements.summary: An overarching information security policy is published, known, and reviewed at least annually.

sub_requirements.title: Acceptable use policies are documented
sub_requirements.summary: Acceptable-use policies for end-user technologies are defined and implemented.

sub_requirements.title: Risks are formally identified and managed
sub_requirements.summary: A formal risk-assessment process identifies, analyzes, and prioritizes risks to the CDE.

sub_requirements.title: PCI DSS compliance is managed
sub_requirements.summary: Executive management assigns responsibility for maintaining/monitoring PCI DSS compliance.

sub_requirements.title: PCI DSS scope is documented and validated
sub_requirements.summary: The CDE scope is documented and validated at least annually and upon significant change.

sub_requirements.title: Security awareness education is ongoing
sub_requirements.summary: A formal security awareness program educates personnel upon hire and at least annually.

sub_requirements.title: Personnel are screened to reduce insider threat risk
sub_requirements.summary: Background checks are performed for personnel prior to hire, within legal constraints.

sub_requirements.title: Risk to information assets from third-party service providers is managed
sub_requirements.summary: Third-party service providers (TPSPs) with access to the CDE are identified, contractually bound, and monitored.

sub_requirements.title: Third-party service providers support their customers' PCI DSS compliance
sub_requirements.summary: TPSPs formally acknowledge responsibility for the security of account data they handle.

sub_requirements.title: Incident response is ready to be activated
sub_requirements.summary: An incident response plan is documented, tested, and ready to activate in case of a suspected/confirmed breach.
